title: Implement atomic quota reservations and finalization
summary: Implemented atomic tenant-scoped quota reservations with PostgreSQL pool locks shared by usage writes, explicit capped/unlimited entitlement snapshots, idempotent reserve/extend/finalize/release/expiry operations, durable usage summaries, bounded maintenance reconciliation, structured safe denials, database guards, documentation, and concurrency/security regression coverage.

migrations: 20260904092000_create_usage_quota_reservations.rb creates tenant-scoped reservations and append-only operation logs with composite foreign keys
and a shared usage-event pool lock without rewriting the usage-event table
decisions: Reservation quantities are billed units at the immutable admitted meter rate
Unlimited capacity is represented explicitly and custom or malformed quota values fail closed
Usage events and every reservation mutation share one PostgreSQL transaction advisory lock per tenant pool and exact period
Existing holds retain their admission snapshot across plan changes while new holds use current entitlement context
Elapsed holds stop consuming capacity immediately and hourly maintenance persists terminal expiry
Raw idempotency keys are stored only as SHA-256 digests with canonical request checksums
risks: Finalized-event reconciliation inspects at most 10000 rows per hourly run; composite foreign keys and immutable database triggers are the primary consistency enforcement
Replacing the usage-event integrity function can wait briefly behind an in-flight usage write during deployment
